description: Bounded Arachne threshold-consumer probes for thin-feature admission, output bead width, first-layer width selection, and short open odd-path filtering.

mutants.description: Ignore the configured minimum input width in the widening strategy. The below-threshold analytic taper band must then appear in the pipeline output.
Discard both regular and initial-layer minimum output widths when constructing the widening strategy. The thin-taper width oracle must fail while mapping controls remain unchanged.
Ignore minimum wall length on ordinary layers. The maximum configured length factor must remove more short open odd paths than the zero boundary.
Reintroduce the numeric-zero fallback for minimum wall length. The registered zero endpoint must map to zero and preserve the short open odd paths that the larger factor removes.
